Subject: Proposal: Premium Support + Integration for Ellipsis Health

Sara —

Thanks again for the discussion today. Attached is the SOW + pricing workbook for the bundled package we discussed: Core API access + Premium Support (24/7), a two-week dedicated onboarding with our Integration Services team, and a scoped connector build for your EMR integration. Key ask: Ellipsis would like a year-one concession to help with adoption: 30% off list on the support retainer and waiving the onboarding setup fee ($18,000).

High-level commercial terms in the workbook:
- Annual list price: $240,000 (support retainer + run-rate)
- Requested concession: 30% off support retainer year 1 (savings ~$36k)
- Onboarding credit: full waiver of $18,000
- PO terms: Net-60 (they prefer 60 days)

We flagged this as an exception request since it exceeds our standard discount thresholds and includes waived onboarding. If you can review and confirm whether we can route as a Deal Desk approval or need exec signoff, that would be great. I’ve copied Tessa and Vivek for visibility.

Attachments: Ellipsis_Master_SOW_v3.pdf, Ellipsis_Pricing_Scenarios.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa

Folks —

Forwarding Sara’s reply. Need quick clarity on whether we can approve the concessions via Deal Desk or require exec signoff. Impact summary below: 

Commercials (proposed vs standard):
- List ARR: $240k
- Requested support discount Y1: 30% of support retainer (~$36k impact Y1)
- Onboarding waiver: $18k one-time margin hit (integration services would still deliver at cost)
- Payment terms: Net-60 (our standard is Net-30 for first-year new logos)

Rationale for concession: Ellipsis is a strategic buyer in behavioral health; referenceable, and their roadmap includes features that integrate tightly with our platform which could open a channel partnership. They committed to a 24-month term and an expansion target in year 2.

Risk notes:
- Giving Net-60 increases cash collection risk (procurement is reputable but slower).
- Waiving onboarding sets a precedent for other mid-market buyers.

Request: Tessa/Vivek — can we approve 30% + waive onboarding, or would you like to propose an alternate split? If you want, I can present the scenarios live.

Quoted text below.

Subject: Exec review requested — Ellipsis Health concession (30% + onboarding waiver)

Vivek —

Summarizing the thread and asking for executive approval. Marissa outlined the ask: 30% off support retainer in year 1 and full waiver of $18k onboarding. PO/terms: Net-60.

Why I’m recommending approval (short):
- Strategic value: Ellipsis is a strong reference in behavioral health; expected expansion to enterprise customers in Y2 (forecasted +$150k incremental ARR).
- Retention: 24-month committed term; higher lifetime value with upsell motion.
- Speed: Procurement has indicated this concession materially affects their timeline — approval could close the deal this week.

Controls/limits: If you approve, recommend we:
1) Convert the concession into a one-time onboarding credit (not a permanent waiver in our pricing model) documented in the SOW.
2) Reduce the off-list discount to 20% instead of 30% and offer an additional performance-based rebate (e.g., if they hit usage thresholds in 12 months, apply another 5% credit retroactively).
3) Require Legal sign the amended SOW with explicit non-precedent language.

Attachment: redlined SOW with proposed language (see Ellipsis_Master_SOW_v3.pdf).

Please advise — if you sign off I’ll notify Legal and Finance to prep PO/invoice schedule and lock in the April 11 kickoff.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec review requested — Ellipsis Health concession (30% + onboarding waiver)

Thanks for the clear summary, Tessa. I’ll approve a constrained concession with the controls you outlined. Final approval below: 

Approved commercial concessions (executive):
- Support discount: up to 20% off the support retainer in year 1 (not 30%).
- Onboarding: approve a one-time onboarding credit up to $18,000, capped at $18k, recorded as a non-recurring credit on invoice (not a permanent price change).
- Payment terms: allow Net-60 for the initial PO for this customer only; Finance to add a 30-day early payment incentive on the invoice (1.5% if paid in 30 days).

Conditions:
1) Legal (Laura) to include non-precedent and approval-limited language in the SOW and add a clause tying the extra ~5% discount (which we declined) to a usage-based KPI if the AE wants to structure a rebate.
2) Marissa to update the pricing workbook and the SOW, capture the concession in HubSpot and attach the redlined SOW.
3) Deal id RDW-DEAL-2027-0891 to be used for all finance tracking.

Marissa — you have approval to move forward under these terms. Please coordinate the DocuSign and confirm PO once received.

—Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
